run_maybe_run_profiler: run the maybe_run_profiler context manager to profile a PyTorch module with xformers and WandB integration
create_ProfilerArgs: create a ProfilerArgs dataclass to configure profiling warmup steps, profile steps, and trace folder settings
convert_perfetto_to_html: convert a perfetto JSON trace file to an HTML viewer using viztracer templates
use_PyTorchProfilerWandb: use PyTorchProfilerWandb to capture PyTorch profiler traces and log them as WandB HTML artifacts
use_MemSnapshotsProfilerWandb: use MemSnapshotsProfilerWandb to capture memory snapshots and log memory trace plots to WandB
